text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Fuji Kiseki's Debut Race. 
Expectations ran high for the promising 
rising star, and much attention was drawn 
to her Trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki pulls out chocolate with a 
magic trick, easing her Trainer's tension. 
Then, she gallantly makes her way toward 
the race...
